// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/surface-composition: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const SURFACES_PROVIDER_ID = "system.surfaces";

export declare const SURFACE_CONSEQUENCES: readonly ["external", "cost", "irreversible"];

export declare const SURFACE_GENERIC_OPERATIONS: readonly ["open", "peek", "place", "hand_off"];

export declare const SURFACE_TASKS: readonly ["writing", "reviewing", "finding", "handing-off", "discussing"];

export type SurfaceConsequence = (typeof SURFACE_CONSEQUENCES)[number];

export interface SurfaceCorrectionInput {
    slot: SurfaceSlot;
    subject?: ActionSubject;
    correction: "form" | "remove" | "pin";
    form?: FormKind;
    position?: number;
    expected_revision: string;
}

export interface SurfaceCorrectionResult {
    corrections_revision: string;
}

export interface SurfaceDescription {
    composed_by: "rules" | "assistant";
    revision: string;
    corrections_revision: string;
    groups: SurfaceGroup[];
    reason?: OwnedTextRef;
}

export interface SurfaceExclusion {
    reason: "disabled";
    count?: number;
    owner_plugin_id?: string;
}

export type SurfaceGenericOperation = (typeof SURFACE_GENERIC_OPERATIONS)[number];

export interface SurfaceGroup {
    kind: "attention" | "continue" | "plugin" | "slot";
    owner_plugin_id?: string;
    state: "ok" | "unreadable" | "stale" | "disabled" | "undeclared";
    read_at?: string;
    excluded?: SurfaceExclusion[];
    hidden_above?: {
        count: number;
        label: OwnedTextRef;
    };
    overflow?: {
        count: number;
        label?: OwnedTextRef;
    };
    title?: OwnedTextRef;
    items: SurfaceItem[];
}

export interface SurfaceItem {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    owner_plugin_id: string;
    form: FormKind;
    state: PresentationValueState;
    read_at?: string;
    fields: Array<{
        key: string;
        role: FieldRole;
    }>;
    actions: SurfaceItemAction[];
    notices?: SurfaceItemNotice[];
    merged?: Array<{
        subject: ActionSubject;
        owner_plugin_id: string;
        relation: ContextRelationType;
    }>;
}

export interface SurfaceItemAction {
    ref: string;
    provider_id?: string;
    primary: boolean;
    prepared_input?: Record<string, string>;
    consequence?: SurfaceConsequence[];
}

export interface SurfaceItemNotice {
    reason: OwnedTextRef;
    next?: SurfaceItemAction;
}

export interface SurfaceRequest {
    slot: SurfaceSlot;
    subjects?: ActionSubject[];
    delivery_subjects?: ActionSubject[];
    expanded?: true;
    task?: SurfaceTask;
}

export interface SurfaceSlot {
    kind: SurfaceSlotKind;
    plugin_id?: string;
    slot_id?: string;
}

export type SurfaceTask = (typeof SURFACE_TASKS)[number];

export declare const surfaceCompositionActions: {
    compose: ActionDefinition<SurfaceRequest, SurfaceDescription>;
    correct: ActionDefinition<SurfaceCorrectionInput, SurfaceCorrectionResult>;
};
